options_evaluated: High-impact virgin ABS/Polycarbonate blend with thick walls
Monomaterial post-consumer recycled polypropylene (PCR-PP) without overmolding
Bio-based PLA composite with glass fiber reinforcement
decisions.conflict: In-Service Agent recommends virgin ABS/PC for high durability and impact resistance, while Circularity Agent rejects this because it introduces non-recyclable polymer blends and lacks recycled content.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: material durability vs. end-of-life recyclability
decisions.chief_resolution: Monomaterial post-consumer recycled polypropylene (PCR-PP) without overmolding, using optimized wall thickness and internal ribbing to achieve the required structural integrity.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the mechanical properties and shrinkage rates of available PCR-PP grades to confirm structural suitability for vacuum cleaner housings.

options_evaluated: Ultrasonic welding and permanent chemical adhesives
Reversible mechanical fasteners (standardized metal screws and snap-fits)
decisions.conflict: Manufacture Agent recommends ultrasonic welding to minimize assembly time, while Circularity Agent rejects this because it creates permanent bonds that prevent non-destructive disassembly and material recovery.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: manufacturing simplicity vs. ease of disassembly and repair
decisions.chief_resolution: Reversible mechanical fasteners (standardized metal screws and snap-fits) to ensure non-destructive disassembly for repair and recycling.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the compatibility of standardized screw sizes across all structural joints to minimize tool requirements for disassembly.

options_evaluated: Standard brushed DC motor with heavy copper windings
High-efficiency BLDC motor with rare-earth magnets designed for non-destructive extraction
Synchronous reluctance motor without permanent rare-earth magnets
decisions.conflict: In-Service Agent recommends a high-efficiency BLDC motor for superior suction and energy efficiency, while Material and Design Agent rejects this due to the high environmental footprint and toxicity of rare-earth magnet extraction.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: operational energy efficiency vs. critical raw material recovery
decisions.chief_resolution: High-efficiency BLDC motor designed for non-destructive magnet and bearing extraction, balancing operational efficiency with end-of-life material recovery.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the market availability of modular BLDC motors that allow clean separation of rotor magnets and copper windings.

options_evaluated: Passive cooling via integrated airflow channels and detachable aluminum heatsinks
Active cooling with a dedicated filtered auxiliary cooling fan
Encapsulated electronics in thermally conductive epoxy resins (potting)
decisions.conflict: In-Service Agent recommends a dedicated filtered auxiliary cooling fan to prevent motor burnout, while Material and Design Agent rejects this because it increases product weight, volume, and material footprint.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: active component reliability vs. material minimization
decisions.chief_resolution: Passive cooling via optimized airflow channels and detachable aluminum heatsinks, supplemented by a thermal cut-off switch for safety.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the thermal limits of the selected motor technology to determine the minimum ventilation area required for passive cooling.

options_evaluated: Modular cartridge design with easily separable functional blocks (motor, battery, filtration)
decisions.conflict: Manufacture Agent recommends a monolithic integrated design to simplify assembly and reduce production waste, while Circularity Agent rejects this because it prevents component-level repair and refurbishment.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: manufacturing waste reduction vs. product life extension
decisions.chief_resolution: Modular cartridge design with easily separable functional blocks, ensuring that high-wear components can be replaced independently.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the interface requirements between major functional blocks to ensure robust electrical and mechanical connections without adding excessive weight.

options_evaluated: Corded AC power supply with integrated cable reel
Removable, modular Li-ion battery pack with toolless release
decisions.conflict: Circularity Agent recommends a removable, modular Li-ion battery pack for cordless convenience and modular recycling, while Material and Design Agent rejects this due to the high environmental footprint and hazardous substances associated with battery chemistry.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: cordless user convenience vs. battery-induced environmental footprint
decisions.chief_resolution: Corded AC power supply with integrated cable reel, which completely avoids battery degradation and hazardous material use.
decisions.design_action: Investigate user mobility requirements and cable reel mechanisms to maximize the reach and usability of the corded design.
